observations.finding: 29 of 50 pathways significant at BH-q<0.05; top pathways include ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION (SMD=1.15, up, q=0), HEME_METABOLISM (SMD=-1.15, down, q=0), IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING (SMD=1.11, up, q=1.2e-05), FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM (SMD=-1.07, down, q=1.2e-05), PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS (SMD=-1.10, down, q=1.7e-05); availability 64 vs 39.
BAP1 mutation frequency 20.3% vs 0% in rest, OR=20.7 (95% CI 1.19-359), Fisher p=0.0016, BH-q=0.034; PBRM1, KDM5C, DST, FLG not significant (q=1.0).

Continuous CNV: 9 of 49 features significant at q<0.05; top chr20q (Cliff's delta=0.46, higher, q=0.013), chr12p (0.43, q=0.018), chr7p (0.42, q=0.022), CDKN2A (-0.39, q=0.027), chr7q (0.39, q=0.027). Gain/loss: no significant at q<0.05; top CDKN2A loss (freq diff 0.226, OR=4.27, q=0.11).

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows strong, coherent pathway activity differences with large effect sizes (SMD>1) and very low q-values, indicating robust separation. WXS shows a single significant BAP1 enrichment with a large odds ratio but wide confidence interval, suggesting uncertainty. CNV continuous analysis shows moderate effect sizes (Cliff's delta ~0.4) with significant q-values, while gain/loss frequencies are not significant after FDR. Overall, RNA and CNV provide coherent support for distinct biology, with WXS contributing a specific mutation signal.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The set is characterized by upregulation of immune-related pathways (allograft rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3) and downregulation of metabolic pathways (heme, fatty acid), along with BAP1 mutations and copy-number gains on 7p/7q/12p/20q and loss of CDKN2A. These features are consistent with a distinct molecular subtype, but no prognostic or treatment claims are made.
limitations: WXS BAP1 odds ratio has a very wide confidence interval due to zero events in the rest group.
CNV gain/loss analyses did not reach significance after FDR correction.
RNA pathway analysis is limited to Hallmark gene sets; other biological processes may be relevant.

observations.finding: Median silhouettes: CT=0.0024, WSI=0.0089, RNA=0.0230, genomic=0.0001; RNA shows the strongest within-set cohesion, genomic the weakest.
Median support count=3 (range 1-4); 21.9% of patients positive in all 4 modalities; no patients with zero positive modalities; lowest support patients have support_count=1 with only RNA positive.

Fused binary probe: child sizes 19/45, normalized cut=0.995, median silhouette=0.0003, resampling median ARI=0.242, consensus separation=0.314, PAC=0.865, degenerate fraction=0.0; modality-specific probe silhouettes: CT=0.012, WSI=0.013, RNA=0.001, genomic=0.00008.

Fused pair median silhouette=0.00038, between-affinity=0.0089 vs within-affinity 0.0092/0.0094; RNA shows strongest boundary (pair median silhouette=0.0258, boundary separation 0.224/0.348), genomic weakest (0.00014).

cross_modal_consistency.statistical_interpretation: The set shows weak to moderate structural consistency across modalities. RNA provides the strongest signal, while genomic and CT are weak. Patient support is moderate (median 3 modalities). The internal probe suggests weak internal structure (low silhouette, low resampling ARI, high PAC), indicating the set may not be tightly cohesive. The boundary to C0002 is weak overall, with RNA providing the most separation.
cross_modal_consistency.medical_interpretation: The set is moderately supported by RNA and WSI, but weakly by CT and genomic. The weak internal structure and boundary suggest that the set may not be a strongly distinct subtype, but this is a structural characterization, not a definitive biological conclusion.
limitations: Resampling was performed on the existing SNF affinity subgraph; modality affinities and SNF were not re-estimated.
Negative PCoA eigenvalues were discarded; PERMDISP is approximate.
Structural metrics describe the current partition and do not independently validate biological subtype identity.

observations.finding: All global tests non-significant: tissue_source_site (Cramer's V=0.157, q=0.869), ct_phase (V=0.112, q=0.869), ct_manufacturer (V=0.066, q=0.869), ct_scanner_model (V=0.0, q=0.892), ct_reconstruction_kernel (V=0.0, q=0.911), numeric fields epsilon-squared=0.0 with q=0.892.

No per-set field reached significance (all q=1.0 except tissue_source_site BP and CJ q=0.992, scanner_model LightSpeed16 q=0.992); largest frequency differences: tissue_source_site BP -0.205 (OR=0.43), CJ +0.131 (OR=7.04), ct_phase UNKNOWN +0.130 (OR=1.75), scanner_model LightSpeed16 -0.217 (OR=0.36); numeric Cliff's delta all <0.06.

confounder_exclusion.statistical_interpretation: No technical variable shows a statistically significant association with the partition after FDR correction. Effect sizes are small (Cramer's V <0.2, epsilon-squared=0, Cliff's delta <0.06). The observed differences in tissue source site and scanner model are not significant and are unlikely to drive the biological signals.
confounder_exclusion.medical_interpretation: The partition does not appear to be confounded by technical acquisition parameters. The biological differences observed are unlikely to be explained by site, scanner, or imaging protocol variations.
limitations: Some categorical levels have zero counts in one group, leading to undefined odds ratios.
Global tests may have limited power due to small sample size.
Only the listed technical fields were assessed; other unmeasured confounders may exist.

observations.finding: ARI=-0.003, homogeneity=0.058, completeness=0.102; contingency shows C0001 has more stage III/IV (30/64) vs C0002 (8/39).

known_label_echo.statistical_interpretation: Both stage and grade show very low overlap with the partition, as indicated by ARI near zero and low homogeneity/completeness values. This suggests the partition is not a simple echo of stage or grade labels.
known_label_echo.medical_interpretation: The partition does not appear to be driven by stage or grade, as the overlap is minimal. This is consistent with the partition capturing molecular features independent of these clinical labels, but it does not establish molecular novelty.
limitations: Only TCGA stage and grade labels are assessable in the current data.
Published molecular ccRCC subtype taxonomies were not evaluated.
Low stage or grade overlap does not by itself establish molecular novelty.
